audit.notes: This format relies on authentic personal 'before' archival pictures of the creator's younger self displaying specific vulnerabilities (braces, bad skin, being out of shape, lonely selfies) alternating with current glow-up b-roll. It cannot be replicated using purely generic lifestyle b-roll without personal historical archives.
audit.summary: A motivational transformation reel showcasing personal before-and-after milestones (skin, braces, gym physique, embracing solo life) framed around the message that good things take time.
